map.比热容和导热系数区别？: Difference Between Specific Heat and Thermal Conductivity?
map.比热容是「能存多少热」（J/kgK），导热系数是「传多快」（W/mK）；保温看重: Specific heat is how much heat can be stored (J/kgK) while thermal conductivity is how fast it conducts (W/mK); insulation depends on the two working together.
map.为什么沿海温差小？: Why Are Coastal Temperature Differences Small?
map.海水比热大，升温降温慢，调节气候；内陆比热小，昼夜/季节温差大。: Seawater has a high specific heat, warming and cooling slowly, which moderates the climate; inland areas have a low specific heat and large day-night and seasonal swings.
